title: Taking Stock of Inventories
summary:
Movements in inventories can impact tanker markets
Few oil publications are followed as closely as the Weekly Petroleum Status Report, published every Wednesday morning by the U.S. It gives a detailed account of weekly U.S. petroleum balances, including domestic oil production, imports, exports and movements in crude oil and petroleum product inventories.
